addendum:
## 📖 Added definitions (glossary backfill)

| Term | Definition |
|------|-----------|
| AR | AR refers to an autoregressive language model that generates tokens sequentially, predicting each token based on previous ones. |
| NVIDIA | NVIDIA is a hardware company that produces the H200 GPU used in the experiments. |
| PR | PR stands for pull request, a contribution to an open-source repository. |
| DDP | DDP refers to Distributed Data Parallel, a technique for training models across multiple GPUs. |
| SFT | SFT stands for supervised fine-tuning, a training method where the model is fine-tuned on labeled data. |
| KV | KV refers to the key-value cache used in transformer models to store attention activations and speed up generation. |
| AIME | AIME stands for the American Invitational Mathematics Examination, used as a benchmark for hard math problems. |
| MT | MT refers to MT-Bench, a benchmark for evaluating multi-turn conversational abilities. |
| APPS | APPS stands for Automated Programming Progress Standard, a benchmark for code generation. |
